name: Turkey and Cheese Pinwheels
steps: Spread the tortillas with cream cheese.
Layer turkey, spinach and cheddar.
Roll tight and slice into rounds.

name: Mini Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix everything and press into a muffin tin.
Brush with a little paste.
Bake at 375°F for 22 to 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Nuggets, Baked with Almond Crumb
steps: Cut the chicken into nuggets.
Dip in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and spices.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 15 to 18 minutes.

name: Fish Sticks, Baked
steps: Cut the cod into sticks.
Dip in egg, then almond flour, parmesan and Old Bay.
Bake at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt dip.

name: Cheese Quesadilla Triangles
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with cheddar and beans and fold.
Crisp in a pan with oil.
Cut into triangles.

name: Ants on a Log
steps: Fill the celery stalks with peanut butter.
Press seeds on top.

name: Banana Dog Roll-Up
steps: Spread the tortillas with peanut butter.
Place a banana on each and roll.

name: Pizza Pasta Bake
steps: Brown the sausage; mix with the cooked pasta, marinara, pepper and seasoning.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot.
Add the potatoes, broth, mustard and paste and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the milk and cheddar.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Quesadilla
steps: Spread peanut butter and banana on half of each tortilla.
Fold and toast in a pan 2 minutes a side.

name: Scrambled Egg Muffin Cups with Ham
steps: Divide the chopped ham, pepper and spinach among six muffin cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and top with cheddar.
Bake at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Yogurt-Dipped Frozen Berries
steps: Stir the vanilla into the yogurt.
Dip the berries and freeze on a tray 2 hours.

name: Lunchbox Turkey Bento with Cheddar Roll-Ups and Blueberries
steps: Roll the turkey around cheddar sticks.
Pack with cucumber, blueberries, almonds and crackers.

name: Sloppy Joes on Hamburger Buns
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Add the sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 12 minutes.
Spoon onto toasted buns.

name: Mac and Cheese Cups with Hidden Cauliflower
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower together; mash the cauliflower.
Stir with the cheddar, milk and egg.
Spoon into muffin cups and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.

name: Taco Pizza on a Tortilla
steps: Brown the turkey with taco seasoning.
Crisp the tortillas, top with turkey and cheddar and bake 6 minutes.
Add tomato, lettuce and salsa.

name: Pigs in a Blanket with Turkey Franks
steps: Cut the tortillas into strips.
Wrap around cheese-topped sausage pieces.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes and serve with mustard.

name: Apple Nachos with Peanut Butter and Pecans
steps: Slice the apples thin on a plate.
Drizzle with warmed peanut butter.
Scatter with pecans, chocolate and cinnamon.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Bites
steps: Mix everything.
Chill 20 minutes.
Roll into twelve balls.

name: Hummus and Veggie Snack Cups
steps: Spoon hummus into four cups.
Stand the cut vegetables in each.

name: Homemade Chicken Noodle Cups
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrot and celery in the broth for 12 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the noodles and cook until tender.

name: Corn Dog Muffins with Turkey Franks
steps: Mix the cooked grits with egg, milk, cheddar and baking powder.
Press into muffin cups around sausage pieces.
Bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Apple Quesadilla
steps: Cook the thin apple slices with cinnamon and butter 3 minutes.
Fill half of each tortilla with apple and cheddar and fold.
Toast 2 minutes a side.

name: Chocolate Banana Frozen Yogurt Pops
steps: Blend everything.
Pour into pop moulds and freeze 4 hours.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Rice Cups
steps: Mix the cooked rice, chopped broccoli, cheddar, egg and milk.
Press into muffin cups.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

name: Egg Salad Lettuce Cups for Lunch
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Spoon into lettuce cups and dust with paprika.
